title: CuisineCraft
description: Minecraft mod that adds several foods to the roster. Most new items only accessible in creative mode.
body:
A mod intended to add a bunch of different foods to Minecraft! Most items are only attainable in creative mode, so the mod is mostly intended for decoration. All foods are edible, though.

## Food items
- Tomato
- Lettuce
- Cheese
- Tater Tots, cookable with Potato Nuggets
- Yogurt, can be crafted by smelting milk
- Pain Au Chocolat, a croissant with chocolate
- Keer, a rice-based dessert
- Kadhi, a yellow curry
- Burger, craftable with bread, tomato, lettuce, and cheese
- Gulabjamun, a syrupy bread dessert (crafted with bread and sugar)
- Rice
- Kadhi Chaval, kadhi with rice!

## Plate
An item that can be right-clicked while holding an item to place it on display, spinning just above the plate.

## Cooker
Block that is only for decoration, a rice cooker.
